g.text: Specialized workflows use the same POST /tasks endpoint.
Dispatch depends on task mode, goal and supplied inputs.
Authenticated use cases require a valid session.
Owner role is checked for model registration
Solid line = actor participation. Hollow triangle = specialization.
«include» = required behavior for a successful coding workflow.
No human-review/resume use case is claimed: it is not an exposed route.
Infrastructure storage and public health probes are omitted for readability.
